text:
Your app speaks every language.
BhashaFix proves it still works.
Local-first. Real browsers, real measurements, and a rerun that a model cannot talk its way past.

AI translates every string in minutes. Teams still ship:

· clipped text
· broken right-to-left layout
· raw translation keys on screen
· dropped placeholders
· controls with no accessible name
· wrong locale metadata

None of these are translation problems. They appear when the string meets the layout, in a browser.

Translation platforms manage the text.
Coding agents modify the code.
Browser testing tools test the interface.

Nobody owns the localisation-specific release gate that connects them — the step that says this build is safe to ship in these twelve languages, and here is the evidence.
REAL CHROMIUM SCAN · GENERATED THROUGH THE CLI

BhashaFix production · 3 routes · 6 screenshots · 10 issues
MDN Web Docs · 3 routes · 6 screenshots · 9 issues
Wikipedia · 2 routes · 4 screenshots · 16 issues

Every screenshot carries its SHA-256, so the image on screen is provably the image the scan captured.

BF-VIS-TEXT-OVERFLOW-X  de-DE

plain      The German button label is cut off.
measured   scrollWidth 245 · clientWidth 168
           overflowPx 77 · overflow-x hidden
predicate  scrollWidth <= clientWidth + 2
A model cannot mark its own answer.

AtlasPay, recorded verified run:
  10 blocking → 0 · source locale PASS

Real Next.js source — .tsx, .css, translation JSON:
  6 blocking → 0
  source locale 0 → 0
  new blockers 0
  3 files, 10 lines
  git apply --check exit 0

CLI · MCP · CI · local or remote browser worker      the engine
Web console                                          evidence and review

The hosted site does not run a browser. Browsers, source code and repair operations stay inside the developer's environment. A portable report can be shared, or opened in the console, without uploading a repository.
A gate they cannot argue with.

Coding agents can generate translations. BhashaFix gives them a release gate they cannot talk their way around.

spawned STDIO process · packages/mcp/dist/bin.js
18 tools · 4 resources · 5 prompts
8 recorded calls published as evidence

inspect → create scan → run → read issues → prepare repair → apply approved IDs → rerun predicates

70 labelled defects · 12 rule families · 12 locales
204 expected detections

Recall 100.0%
Precision 100.0%
False positives on the clean variant 0

Two real rule defects were found by scanning public sites and fixed in the rules, not worked around.

npx @bhashafix/cli scan --url http://localhost:3000 \
  --locales en-GB,de-DE,ar-SA,ja-JP

Not claimed: hosted browser rendering; arbitrary-repository repair; native-quality translation; Firefox or WebKit coverage.
